topbar.text: Industrial sourcing from India for European buyers

home.hero_title: Your second source in India — held to European standards.
home.hero_lead: Velanix Sourcing gives European procurement teams a vetted manufacturing base in India. We take your drawings and specifications, match them to audited suppliers, coordinate samples and oversee production and quality through to delivery at your site.
hero_points: Suppliers audited on site in India
Samples approved before any series order
QA checkpoints through to EU delivery
home.quick_sub: Choose a category to open its specification form. Takes about five minutes.
home.quick_note: NDA on request · Drawings handled confidentially
home.why_title: Diversify your supply base without adding risk
home.why_lead: Most European buyers don't need another marketplace. They need a qualified alternative for parts they already buy — and someone accountable for making it work.

why_items.title: Second-sourcing, not just cost-down
why_items.text: Reduce dependency on a single region or supplier. We build a qualified alternative source for existing parts, so a disruption elsewhere doesn't stop your line.

why_items.title: Vetted, not listed
why_items.text: We are not a directory. Every supplier we propose has been visited and assessed on process capability, quality system and export readiness — then matched to your part.

why_items.title: Compliance captured up front
why_items.text: CE, REACH, RoHS, PED, MDR, EN 10204 certificates, PPAP: requirements are part of the specification from day one, not discovered at goods-in inspection.

why_items.title: One accountable partner
why_items.text: A single contact in the EU, in your language and time zone, with our own people on the ground in India following every order.

home.categories_lead: Seven product lines where Indian manufacturing is deep, export-proven and a strong fit for European specifications. Each has its own specification form.
home.how_title: From drawing to delivery in five stages
home.how_lead: A structured process modelled on OEM supplier development — so you always know where your part stands and what comes next.
home.matrix_title: Processes, standards and clusters at a glance
home.matrix_lead: Where we source each category and which standards our suppliers are qualified against.
home.matrix_note: Lead times are indicative, ex-works, and depend on part complexity, tooling and material availability.
home.belt_title: Deep roots in India's Coimbatore engineering belt
belt_text: Our supplier network starts in western Tamil Nadu. Coimbatore is one of India's oldest engineering centres — home to foundries, pump and motor makers, textile-machinery builders and precision machine shops that have supplied export customers for decades. Madurai, Karur and Hosur add automotive components and home textiles.

We know these clusters first-hand, which is why we can move from drawing to qualified supplier quickly. Where a category is stronger elsewhere in India — carpets in Panipat and Bhadohi, cable in Gujarat — we extend the same vetting process to those regions.
home.cases_title: What a Velanix programme looks like
home.cases_lead: Typical projects we are set up to run, from RFQ to repeat orders.

cases.title: Second source for stainless ball valves
cases.challenge: A valve distributor relied on one Asian source for DN50–DN200 PN40 ball valves in CF8M.
cases.approach: Qualify a Coimbatore foundry-and-machining supplier, witness EN 12266 tests on first articles, EN 10204 3.1 certificates with every lot.
cases.outcome: Dual-sourced range with split volumes and a fallback for peak demand.

cases.title: Machined hubs for an agricultural OEM supplier
cases.challenge: A tier-2 supplier needed extra capacity for forged and machined steel hubs.
cases.approach: IATF 16949 supplier in the Madurai / Hosur belt, APQP plan, PPAP level 3 submission and run-at-rate before SOP.
cases.outcome: Series supply with pre-shipment inspection on every consignment.

cases.title: Certified cotton bed linen range
cases.challenge: A retailer wanted to diversify private-label bed linen beyond a single country.
cases.approach: Karur mills with OEKO-TEX and GOTS certification, lab dips and size sets approved in Austria, AQL 2.5 final inspection.
cases.outcome: Seasonal programme with repeat orders managed by Velanix.

home.fta_title: EU–India FTA: upside, not the business case
home.fta_text: The EU–India Free Trade Agreement is expected to take effect after ratification, likely around 2027–28. When it applies, lower duties on many industrial goods will be a welcome bonus. We don't build your business case on it: every quote we present uses today's duty rates, so the sourcing decision stands on quality, resilience and total landed cost.
home.cta_title: Have a part that needs a second source?
home.cta_text: Send us a drawing and a target volume. We'll confirm feasibility and next steps within two business days.

steps.title: Specification intake
steps.text: Share drawings, tolerances, quantities, target price and compliance requirements. We check completeness and confirm scope.

steps.title: Supplier matching
steps.text: We shortlist two to three vetted suppliers from the right cluster, collect quotes and present a comparison with a landed-cost view.

steps.title: Samples & sign-off
steps.text: Samples or first articles are produced, inspected by us in India and shipped to you. No series order without your written approval.

steps.title: Production & QA
steps.text: Order placement, production tracking, in-process and pre-shipment inspection, export documentation and logistics to your EU site.

steps.title: Account management
steps.text: Repeat orders, schedule changes, supplier performance reviews and continuous improvement — one contact throughout.

buyers.title: A sourcing process built like an OEM purchasing department
buyers.lead: You get the discipline of structured supplier development — RFQ, qualification, first-article approval, controlled production — without building a team in India.
deliverables: Open-points list on drawings and requirements
Quote comparison incl. tooling, freight and duty
buyers.timeline_lead: Typical durations for a machined or cast part of moderate complexity. Parts needing new tooling or complex certification take longer; catalogue items are faster.
buyers.sample_title: No series order without your sign-off
sample_points: Every new part goes through samples or first-article inspection before a production order is placed.
Samples are inspected by Velanix in India against your drawing before they are shipped.
Sample and tooling costs are quoted transparently up front. Tooling is typically owned by the buyer once paid.
You approve in writing using a sample approval form; deviations are recorded and resolved with the supplier.
Approved samples become the reference ('golden sample') for series inspections.
buyers.qa_title: Four checkpoints between drawing and your goods-in

qa_items.title: Supplier audit
qa_items.text: On-site assessment of process capability, quality system, measuring equipment, capacity and export experience before a supplier is proposed.

qa_items.title: First-article approval
qa_items.text: Dimensional reports, material certificates and — where required — PPAP or FAI documentation, reviewed by us before anything is shipped to you.

qa_items.title: In-process inspection
qa_items.text: Visits during production for new parts and critical characteristics, to catch issues before a full lot is completed.

qa_items.title: Pre-shipment inspection
qa_items.text: Final random inspection to ISO 2859-1 (AQL) with a photo report and your go / no-go before the goods are released for dispatch.

buyers.qa_note: Independent third-party inspection (SGS, TÜV, Bureau Veritas) can be arranged on request.
buyers.commercial_text: Velanix doesn't hold stock or manufacture. We are compensated through a transparent agency fee or commission on orders placed, agreed per programme before the first quote. You see the supplier's price; there is no hidden margin buried in the unit cost.
commercial_points: Free RFQ review and feasibility feedback
Commission or agency fee on placed orders — agreed up front
Optional paid inspection and QA services for your existing Indian suppliers
buyers.logistics_text: We quote on your preferred Incoterm — from FOB Chennai / Tuticorin to DDP your warehouse — and coordinate export documentation, freight forwarding and EU customs clearance with our forwarding partners.

faq.a: Depending on your preference, you either buy directly from the Indian supplier with Velanix as your agent, or through Velanix on agreed terms. We will recommend the structure that fits your purchasing process.

faq.q: How do you protect our drawings?
faq.a: We sign an NDA with you before receiving drawings if you wish, and every supplier signs an NDA with us before they see any of your documents. Drawings are only shared with shortlisted suppliers.

faq.q: What minimum order quantities do you handle?
faq.a: It depends on the category and process. As a guide, castings and forgings make sense from a few hundred pieces per year; textiles from a few hundred units per design. Send us your volumes and we'll tell you honestly if the fit is right.

faq.q: What happens if a lot fails inspection?
faq.a: Non-conforming goods are not released. We agree corrective actions with the supplier, including rework, replacement and 8D reports, and track them to closure.

faq.q: Do you only work with suppliers in Tamil Nadu?
faq.a: Tamil Nadu is our strongest base, but not a limit. For each category we source from the clusters where capability is strongest, applying the same vetting process everywhere.

suppliers.title: Grow your European business with a partner who knows both sides
suppliers.lead: Velanix brings qualified RFQs from European industrial buyers to Indian manufacturers who can meet European standards — and supports you through samples, documentation and repeat orders.

why_items.title: Qualified RFQs
why_items.text: Complete drawings, realistic volumes and clear compliance requirements — not price-shopping enquiries.

why_items.title: European buyer expectations, explained
why_items.text: We translate EU requirements — PPAP, EN 10204, CE, REACH, packaging and labelling — into a clear checklist for your team.

why_items.title: Long-term programmes
why_items.text: Our buyers are looking for second sources and repeat supply, not one-off orders.

why_items.title: Local support
why_items.text: Our team in Coimbatore visits suppliers, supports sample approvals and follows production with you.

criteria: Own manufacturing facility (not trading) in one of our categories
ISO 9001 at minimum; IATF 16949, ISO 13485, PED or OEKO-TEX / GOTS where the category requires it
Calibrated measuring and testing equipment appropriate to the parts
Export experience, ideally to Europe, the US or Japan
Material traceability and ability to issue EN 10204 3.1 certificates (engineering categories)
Compliance with labour, health & safety and environmental law — and openness to social-compliance audits
Willingness to sign an NDA and work to European documentation standards

vetting_steps.title: Approved supplier
vetting_steps.text: You join the Velanix network and receive matched RFQs. Performance is reviewed regularly.

about.title: An EU-based sourcing partner with roots in Indian manufacturing
about.lead: We connect European industrial buyers with the manufacturers in India best placed to build their parts — and stay accountable until those parts arrive, to specification, at their site.
story: European buyers increasingly want a second manufacturing base outside their existing supply regions. India has the engineering depth to be that base, but finding the right supplier, qualifying them and managing quality from a distance is hard — especially for mid-sized buyers without a local team.
Velanix exists to close that gap. We combine European procurement practice with local presence in India's manufacturing clusters, starting with the Coimbatore engineering belt we know best.
does: Order execution, production follow-up and QA oversight
doesnt: Run an open marketplace or sell supplier leads

privacy: We process the personal data you provide in our forms (name, business contact details, company information and uploaded documents) solely to respond to your enquiry, prepare quotations and manage the resulting business relationship (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR).
Drawings and technical documents are shared only with shortlisted suppliers who have signed a confidentiality agreement. Data is stored on servers within the EU.

Enquiries that do not lead to a business relationship are deleted after 24 months. You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection, and may lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority (Datenschutzbehörde).
